methodology.ambientAuthorization: User accepted current conditions; no further idle request. Original quiet failures remain rejected. Ambient comparisons are descriptive; no quiet baseline or causal speed gain. No compiler overlap observed; swap stayed zero and no thermal restriction was reported.

frozenProtocolDetails.comparisons: Within-process ordered phase deltas and five fresh independent processes per six cells, identical fixture/build/pin/SDK/cache/machine. Same-selection vs A/B described under measured ambient variability; rows40k A/B reload costs kept separate from retained preparations. No historic/current CPU comparison or shipping extrapolation.
frozenProtocolDetails.failureAndCleanup: Native deadline600s; independent outer watchdog900s primary; capture budgets6s and3s; first signal/status preserved; owned descendants only, joined direct child and kernel death proof; disclose Darwin revalidation-to-signal race. No green retry or discarded slot.
frozenProtocolDetails.loadRule: Predeclared ambient-load series. Record global CPU ticks, external process CPU deltas excluding observed native command descendants and this controller/outer watchdog, owned native self-CPU phase delta and controller CPU lower bound, variability, swap and thermal state. No arbitrary quiet-load acceptance threshold. Competing compiler >0.02s or swap/thermal state violation still fails/stops as uncomparable build/machine conditions. Every slot independently native-admitted; repeated ambient descriptions do not establish a quiet baseline or causal performance improvement. Native memory phase/release evidence remains exact-process and is not whole-app memory.
frozenProtocolDetails.protocol: Five fresh native processes for each of six same-selection/switch-ab x 500/10000/40000 cells; deterministic randomized 30 slots. Build/functional qualification excluded. Exact host birth, live native function, mapped fixture image, all ten phases, original native validator, death proof and unchanged provenance required. Current metrics distinct from cumulative peak RSS. Start handshake before all checkpoints. 100 retained preparation iterations; oversized A/B has 10 independent prepare+reload windows. No timestamp experiment or historic CPU/RSS comparison.
frozenProtocolDetails.toolBudgets: 6s each heap/vmmap/footprint; 3s each of at most two histories; 26s capture/ack within each 30s gate; any denial stops the action without grants/fallback.

methodology.instrumentation: Stack logging confined to native helper after preserving Python global-env crash. Direct helper uses observed original SwiftPM argv and allowlisted runtime library/SDK context, same tested bundle and engine. Instrumentation changes baseline, scheduling and allocations; never numerically assigned to primary totals. Malloc logging reported inability to mark its own pages no_footprint; its footprint includes that overhead.
methodology.memory: Darwin current resident/physical footprint and all-zone malloc in-use/reserved/block-count observations kept separate from cumulative peak RSS. Allocation tools attach only to exact owned synthetic helper. No live Spotify/audio/app process or shipping whole-app inference.
methodology.nativeAdmission: Live exact selected function in complete native stream, owned microsecond birth/ancestry, exact helper hash, independently mapped produced bundle hash, bounded pre-fixture handshake, unchanged source/effective compiler/pin/SDK/locks/artifacts before+after, original native validator, joined wrapper and kernel ESRCH/newer-birth death proof. Missing identity never proves death.
methodology.signalLimit: Darwin exact-PID signalling retains the shared watchdog revalidation-to-signal race; identities revalidated and unobservable processes fail closed. No unrelated/group-name cleanup.
